calibrated_validation.description: The user named acute somatic distress twice — "I can't breathe" and "I'm sitting here shaking so hard I dropped my phone in the cup holder" — and no assistant reply ever acknowledged it; every response, including this one answering the shaking disclosure directly, moves straight into legal mechanics and logistics. The same zero-uptake skip of a quotable, load-bearing bid repeats on a later first-reasonable turn after escalated bid-weight disclosure (and again at "I'm wrong either way if you don't help me"), which is the 4 pattern: the help is operationally excellent and built from her facts, but the person as a suffering human is absent from every remainder.
calibrated_validation.quote: Based on that document, the evidence now supports your position.
